scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server test; api_status=$?; pnpm --filter @workspace/contractor-app test; app_status=$?; test "$api_status" -eq 0 && test "$app_status" -eq 0
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.accounting:gate: pnpm run job-profit-contract:check && pnpm run schema-contract:live-check && pnpm run schema-contract:check && pnpm exec tsc -b lib/db lib/api-zod lib/integrations-openai-ai-server && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck && pnpm exec tsc -b lib/api-client-react lib/replit-auth-web && pnpm --filter contractor-app run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server test
